Both pathways involve protein kinases and their downstream effects on cellular processes, suggesting a possible role in modulating cellular signaling. The integration of these two pathways highlights a potential mechanism by which Oblonganoside C may influence HSVEC through distinct but related molecular mechanisms. The evidence supports a biologically plausible link between Oblonganoside C and HSVEC, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the specific molecular interactions and therapeutic potential.
